company_profile: team.it is a Portuguese IT consultancy that builds AI, data and digital transformation projects for large clients, especially in financial services.
title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
summary: AI Engineer with 8+ years building machine learning, deep learning and Generative AI solutions from prototype to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs LLM applications with RAG, LangChain and LangGraph, including multi-agent assistants and document-extraction agents, with automated evaluation and monitoring. Develops the APIs, SQL and PySpark data pipelines and MLOps around them with PyTorch, FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes and MLflow. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Banking Policy Q&A Agent
bullets: Built an agentic RAG assistant that answered questions over banking policy and product documents, combining a vector database, LangGraph tool routing and Claude through AWS Bedrock.
Evaluated answer quality with LLM evaluators on a labelled question set, traced each agent step, and served the assistant as a FastAPI service in Docker on Kubernetes.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Artificial Intelligence Engineer role. As a senior AI engineer in healthcare I build LLM applications with RAG and LangGraph, from a multi-agent analytics assistant to a document-extraction agent, and take them into production. The thread in my work is making GenAI dependable enough for large organisations to rely on.

team.it builds AI for major financial-sector clients, and bringing assistants and agent-based systems into banks, where accuracy and care matter, is work I want to do more of. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Portugal together and settle there long term. A hybrid role in Portugal fits that plan well.

I would bring production experience with the stack you list. I built a RAG assistant in LangGraph that reached a 90% match rate against existing solutions, and evaluation and monitoring pipelines for question-answering agents that cut human review by 43%. I also work comfortably across APIs, SQL, Docker and Kubernetes.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It has taught me to build for real users and to test carefully before anything reaches them. I would be glad to talk about how I could help your teams.
